name: frontend
summary: Outcome pass on the five workflows a fullstack developer runs daily: `/add-crud-page` gains a data-sensitivity gate ranked above the shape gate (the walk that produced a repo-owned card-number input now halts), a sibling census that makes the `gap_count` hard rule evaluable at n=0 and n=1, and a cross-row store verb class; `dev-server-start` resolves the workspace member before probing a port; `a11y-scan` opens every menu/dialog/tab and reports an interactive-surface row; `lighthouse-ci` gains the attribution step its halt already demanded plus the pack's performance triage router; `verify-with-playwright` derives its flow from the diff and detects the locale mechanism instead of hard-reloading `?lang=`.
